text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: API-Gateway-5xx-surge (P1). Pager: @oncall-alex. Root cause unknown, rally in #incidents.
oncall-alex: seeing a spike in 502/504 across edge-proxies in us-west1 and eu-central. Alert shows 18% 5xx for the last 3m. Tagging @eng-sre-sam and @netops-maya.
eng-sre-sam: acknowledged. Pulling logs now. Can someone confirm any recent deploys?
ops-luis: we had a traffic config push 6m ago that adjusted health-check timeouts for the new routing policy. Deploy was small but targeted to edge pool-3.
eng-sre-sam: copying logs: ```
[2026-03-15T12:03:05Z] gw-proxy-3 conn_reset backend <ip>: connection reset by peer
[2026-03-15T12:03:07Z] gw-proxy-2 upstream_timeout backend-service 10.5s
[2026-03-15T12:03:09Z] gw-proxy-4 502: handoff to fallback
```
netops-maya: seeing SYN_RECV backpressure and elevated retries on the backend cluster nodes in us-west1. CPU on backend-1 spiking to 90% and ephemeral port exhaustion creeping up.
support-jane: customer-impact dashboard shows 12k failed requests in last 10m, mostly user-facing API POST /v1/execute. Customer-facing error rate ~7% for active tenants in us-west1. Notified CS triage.
oncall-alex: priority actions: 1) enable ingress circuit-breaker to reduce fanout, 2) shift traffic away from us-west1 to us-east1 and eu-central, 3) revert the routing health-check change if it's the culprit. Who can toggle circuit-breaker?
eng-sre-sam: I can do the CB. Running: `redwoodctl route update --circuit-breaker=enabled --threshold=0.2 --scope=edge` now.
incident-bot: Command accepted, change queued at 1769990032.
eng-sre-sam: CB applied on control-plane. Observing drop in concurrent upstream connections. 5xx rate down to 9% from 18% within 90s.
netops-maya: initiating traffic shift: `traffic-shift --from=us-west1 --to=us-east1 --pct=50 --dry-run=false`. Starting gradual 10% increments.
ops-luis: reverting health-check timeout change now: `kubectl -n infra apply -f /configs/edge-health-revert.yaml` (rolling restart of proxies will follow).
product-ryan: any immediate customer comms we should push? CS wants an incident blurb for status.redwood.ai.
support-jane: drafting: "We are investigating elevated 502/504 errors affecting some requests in US-West. Mitigation in progress; traffic being shifted. We'll update in 15 minutes." Will post when we have stable numbers.
eng-sre-sam: quick note: got a backend stack trace indicating connection pools hit max and some worker threads restarted: ```
E 12:04:11 pool exhausted, wait timeout
E 12:04:12 worker process 1437 restarted
```
oncall-alex: next: scale backend pool by +30% in us-west1 and increase ephemeral port range to reduce connection churn. @netops-maya can you do the scale?
netops-maya: scaling backend ASG now: desired=60 -> 78. Increase ephemeral ports on NAT nodes to 31000-61000. Pushing sysctl changes.
ops-luis: rolling restart of the proxy pool done, health-check config reverted. Proxies reporting healthy.
incident-bot: TL;DR: circuit-breaker enabled, traffic shifted (50% to us-east1), backend scale +30%, health-check revert applied.
eng-sre-sam: 5xx at 5% and trending down. Latency for successful requests stable. Connection resets reduced.
support-jane: posted initial status update to status page and sent a notice to impacted account owners.
product-ryan: need to track postmortem owners and user-impact metrics. Suggest tagging this with "slo-impact" and assign to eng-sre for RCA.
oncall-alex: handing off to second on-call in 30m. @eng-sre-sam you'll take the overnight watch for regression and RCA coordination?
eng-sre-sam: I have it. Will keep monitoring for 2 hours then hand to next rotation. I'll start collecting perf traces and relevant config diffs.
ops-luis: quick snippet from proxy logs after mitigations: ```
[12:12:03] gw-proxy-3 upstream success latency 120ms
[12:12:05] gw-proxy-2 502 count decreased
```
netops-maya: marking network changes in change log: CHG-2026-0315-007.
support-jane: adding a support playbook note for CS: template for acknowledging the outage and explaining mitigation steps (circuit-breaker + traffic shift + scaling + config revert).
incident-bot: Reminder: create incident ticket INC-1769999999 and tag with P1, owners: eng-sre-sam, netops-maya, ops-luis, support-jane.
eng-sre-sam: beginning data capture for RCA: heap / file descriptor usage, kernel tcp metrics, nginx proxy states, backend worker thread restarts. Will attach to INC ticket.
oncall-alex: before I drop, quick check: any sign of external DDoS or bot traffic spike?
netops-maya: WAF shows normal bot score distribution, so internal config change + backend capacity seems root. No unusual client IP patterns.
product-ryan: will coordinate customer comms follow-up, CS will send tailored emails for top 10 impacted.
oncall-alex: OK thanks team — good mitigation. Handoff in 30m to @eng-sre-sam. If error rates cross 8% again, escalate to SRE lead.
eng-sre-sam: acknowledging handoff and will update incident timeline. Planning follow-ups: add e2e test for health-check changes, tighten deploy gating for edge routing, and review connection pool settings in backend.
ops-luis: leaving a note: we'll also add a temporary traffic steer policy to limit new feature rollout to 10% until RCA complete.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Current state: degraded -> stabilizing. Next update scheduled in 30 minutes or on significant change.
